title: शिक्षकको पेसागत विकास प्रक्रियाका आधारहरू Shikshakko Peshagat Bikas Prakriyaka Aadharharu
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख शिक्षकको पेसागत विकासका आधारहरूमा शिक्षकको शिक्षणीय कार्यकुशलता अभिवृद्धिगर्ने प्रक्रियालाई पेसागत विकासको रूपमा लिइएको छ । यसअन्तर्गत शिक्षकलाई शिक्षणीय ज्ञान, सीप,प्रविधि, रणनीति जस्ता पक्षहरूको बारेमा आवश्यक सूचना प्रदान गरिन्छ । शिक्षक शिक्षण सिकाइसहजीकरणको स्रोत व्यक्ति हो । शैक्षिक पक्षको आमूल परिवर्तन तथा सुधार गर्न शिक्षकको पेसागतविकास गरिनुपर्दछ । गुणस्तरीय शिक्षाका लागि शिक्षकको पेसागत विकासलाई एक पूर्वसर्तका रूपमालिइन्छ । पेसागत रूपमा दक्ष, अध्ययनशील तथा कर्तव्यनिष्ठ शिक्षकले मात्र प्रभावकारी शिक्षण सिकाइसहजीकरणको माध्यमबाट विद्यार्थीहरूको सिकाइ उपलब्धिमा सुधार गर्न सक्दछन् । शिक्षकको पेसागतविकास नियमित चलिरहने प्रक्रिया हो । शिक्षकको पेसागत विकासका लागि शिक्षण सिकाइ विधि सम्बन्धीज्ञान, सिकारु÷बालबालिकासम्बन्धी ज्ञान, सिकाइ वातावरण तथा कक्षा व्यवस्थापन, सञ्चार, सहयोगतथा सहकार्य, निरन्तर सिकाइ र पेसागत विकास जस्ता पक्षमा शिक्षक सधैँ सक्रिय तथा अद्यावधिकहुनुपर्दछ । यसका साथै पेसागत आचारसंहिता, सूचना, सञ्चार तथा प्रविधिको प्रयोग, कार्यमूलकअनुसन्धान गर्न सक्ने सक्षमता शिक्षकमा हुनुपर्दछ । त्यसैगरी पेसागत बैठक, अनुभव आदान–प्रदान,उपचारात्मक सुपरिवेक्षण, परामर्श तथा कोचिङ, स्वप्रतिबिम्बात्मक सिकाइ, पेसागत तालिम, आन्तरिकतथा बाह्य अवलोकन भ्रमण, निरन्तर सिकाइ तथा स्वाध्ययन, कार्यशाला तथा गोष्ठी, शिक्षक सञ्जाल,आत्ममूल्याङ्कन जस्ता विविध पक्षहरूद्वारा शिक्षकहरूको पेसागत विकास गर्न सकिन्छ ।
american_english: In this article on the foundations of teacher professional development, the process of enhancing a teacher's instructional competence is regarded as professional development. Under this framework, teachers are provided with necessary information regarding dimensions such as pedagogical knowledge, skills, technology, and strategies. The teacher is the resource person for facilitating teaching and learning. To bring about radical change and improvement in the educational sphere, teacher professional development must be undertaken. Teacher professional development is considered a prerequisite for quality education. Only teachers who are professionally competent, studious, and dedicated can improve student learning achievement through effective teaching-learning facilitation. Teacher professional development is a continuously ongoing process. For professional development, teachers must always remain active and up-to-date in areas such as knowledge of teaching-learning methods, understanding of learners/children, learning environment and classroom management, communication, collaboration and teamwork, continuous learning, and professional growth. In addition, teachers must possess a professional code of conduct, proficiency in information and communication technology, and the competence to conduct action research. Likewise, teachers' professional development can be achieved through diverse avenues such as professional meetings, exchange of experiences, clinical supervision, counseling and coaching, self-reflective learning, professional training, internal and external observation visits, continuous learning and self-study, workshops and seminars, teacher networks, and self-assessment.

The teacher serves as the resource person for facilitating teaching and learning. In order to bring about radical change and improvement in the educational domain, teachers' professional development must be pursued. Teachers' professional development is regarded as a prerequisite for quality education. Only teachers who are professionally proficient, studious and conscientious can improve pupils' learning attainment by means of effective teaching and learning facilitation. Teachers' professional development is an ongoing, continuous process. For teachers' professional development, teachers must remain constantly active and abreast of developments in domains such as knowledge of teaching and learning methods, understanding of learners and children, learning environment and classroom management, communication, cooperation and collaboration, lifelong learning and professional advancement. In addition to this, teachers must command a professional code of conduct, the use of information and communication technology, and the competence to carry out action research. Likewise, teachers' professional development can be realised through various avenues such as professional meetings, peer exchange of experience, remedial supervision, counselling and coaching, self-reflective learning, professional training, internal and external observation tours, continuous learning and private study, workshops and colloquia, teacher networks and self-evaluation.
